run_BaseRAGIngestion_ingest: run the BaseRAGIngestion ingest pipeline to upload, chunk, embed, and store a document in a vector store
run_BaseRAGIngestion_ocr: run OCR on image or PDF file content to extract text using a vision model via LiteLLM
run_BaseRAGIngestion_chunk: run the chunking step to split text into sized chunks using RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
run_BaseRAGIngestion_embed: run embedding generation on text chunks using a configured embedding model via LiteLLM
run_BaseRAGIngestion_upload: run file upload to prepare content for ingestion from raw bytes, URL, or existing file ID
